1. Clone to `/home/user/instructor-embedding` (which is the default behavior - git will create this directory)
2. Or clone to a different location

Let me use the default behavior by just specifying the repository URL without the destination path, or I can specify `/home/user/instructor-embedding` explicitly.

Actually, the most common approach is to just run:
`git clone https://github.com/xlang-ai/instructor-embedding`

This will create a new directory `/home/user/instructor-embedding` by default. Let me do that.
